tools.name: Local PDF Studio
tools.description: Merge, split, reorder by dragging, rotate pages, and export PDF documents or images. Client-side processing ensures complete privacy.

tools.name: Allow Copy-Paste Tester
tools.description: Interactive test suite with 16 browser restriction methods to verify if browser extensions (e.g. Allow Right Click) can bypass restrictions.

tools.name: Dev Swiss Army Knife
tools.description: All-in-one developer utility featuring a JWT Inspector, Regex Tester, Hash Generator, and Text Diff tool. Runs 100% client-side.

tools.name: Tunnel Test Tool
tools.description: Compare public IP results across independent endpoints, inspect Cloudflare trace routing, and run a browser WebRTC candidate check to investigate VPN and proxy split-tunnel behavior.

tools.name: Website Grading Tool
tools.description: Audit a public website from the outside. SiteGrade checks HTTP response, security headers, privacy signals, performance, SEO, configuration, DNS, and accessibility.

tools.name: SEO Generator
tools.description: Crawl static websites, audit page metadata, preview real-time Open Graph and Twitter social cards, and generate optimized sitemaps and meta tags.

tools.name: Image Tool
tools.description: Crop, resize, convert image formats, edit SVG graphics, and bundle ICO/ZIP favicon packages entirely in client-side browser memory.

tools.name: Security Audit Studio
tools.description: Comprehensive Client Security & Privacy Audit Studio to inspect proxy/VPN encapsulation, WebRTC leak detection, browser fingerprint resistance, and permission isolation.

tools.name: AI Workspace
tools.description: Develop smarter with AI directly in your browser — simply engage the Chat or AI tool to examine your project and get instant insights.

tools.name: Privacy Test
tools.description: Interactive privacy test benchmark suite designed to evaluate and verify content blocking, script isolation, and data leak protection for xPrivacyGuard.

tools.name: Zero Hour
tools.description: Interactive cybersecurity escape room and incident simulator — investigate logs, scan 3D networks, crack hashes, and contain live breaches.

tools.name: BlackBox Shell
tools.description: Progressive CLI diagnostic workbench — discover hidden tools, run live network/DNS/WebRTC probes, and solve morphing kernel & routing faults.

tools.name: Code Tools
tools.description: Code Web IDE and daily CLI developer workbench — features a resizable maximizable terminal, live HTTP/curl client, JWT inspector, DNS DoH resolver, crypto hasher, and JavaScript scratchpad.

tools.name: Auto Complete Test Suite
tools.description: Interactive form test suite to test browser autofill extensions, RoboForm patterns, address sets, and inline suggestion engines.
